description: This header file defines functions for automatically adjusting the timezone in response to changes in the CPE_TZ property. It includes declarations for registering and disabling the timezone auto-adjustment functionality.

methods.name: autoAdjustTimezone
methods.description: Registers the process as a property change listener for the CPE_TZ property and updates the timezone accordingly.

methods.name: disableAutoAdjustTimezone
methods.description: Stops listening for changes to the CPE_TZ property.
